title: Notification bell renders in the Navbar for an authenticated session
steps: Log in and land on any private-layout page
expectedResult: The bell icon is visible in the Navbar, and clicking it opens NotificationMenu without a console error.

title: GET /api/notifications/unread-count returns 200 with a numeric count
preconditions: Valid JWT for any authenticated user
expectedResult: 200 response: { success: true, data: { count: <number> } } where count >= 0.

title: GET /api/notifications/client returns 200 with a notifications array and pagination object
preconditions: Valid JWT for any authenticated user
expectedResult: 200 response containing data.notifications (array), data.pagination (total/page/limit/totalPages), and data.unreadCount (number).

title: Socket.IO client connects and receives a 'connect' event with a valid session token
preconditions: User is logged in and a project is selected
steps: Load any page inside the private layout (NotificationProvider mounted)
Open the browser console and confirm the socket connection log
expectedResult: Console shows '[SOCKET] Connected...' and a socket id; connectionStatus in NotificationContext becomes 'connected'.

title: POST /api/internal/notifications with a correct token is reachable and returns 201
steps: POST /api/internal/notifications with a correct X-Internal-Token and a minimal valid body
expectedResult: 201 response with { success: true, data: { id: <notificationId> } }, confirming the microservice-facing endpoint is up and correctly wired for basic dispatch.
